NoteSeed: Derives the note, note commitment cm, and master key from the value, note randomness, and proof-authorizing key.
NullifierDerive: Derives a window of evolving nullifiers from NoteSecret and checks the NfSeqPoly encoding. The sequence is committed in output slot 0; the header binds cm and the epoch range.
NullifierFuse: Joins adjacent nullifier windows for the same cm and checks the merged sequence polynomial.
SpendableInit: Checks cm is a root of the creation stamp set and folds that set into the anchor for the creation epoch. It reads cm from NoteNullifiers, not NoteSecret. It does not prove exclusion; the eventual consensus anchor check binds the witnessed creation data to the chain.
QrSpendableInit: Combines note-bound exclusion with a sealed bucket containing the note commitment to initialize spendability at the next epoch entry.
SpendableLift: Extends a note's spendable position using adjacent note-bound exclusion evidence, with matching cm and boundary anchors.
SpendBind: Matches cm in NoteSpendable and NoteSecret, derives the current and next epoch nullifiers, carries the note’s payment key, and commits the positive note value into cv using rcv.
OutputBind: Derives the output note commitment and padding tachygram, and commits the negated note value into cv using rcv.
OutputAction: Encodes the output as an action and checks the action/tachygram polynomials at the witnessed anchor.
SpendAction: Encodes the spend as an action, binding authorization to pak and theta, and checks the action/tachygram polynomials.
SummarySeed: Starts a nonempty stamp summary. The same stamp set is committed in both slots: accumulated and last stamp. Its bridge hash determines the anchor fold.
SummaryAdvance: Checks extended = accumulated × new stamp at the polynomial challenge, then advances the anchor. Slot 0 holds the extended set; slot 1 holds only the new stamp.
QrSummaryIntake: Copies the summary's accumulated set into a root-profile intake and binds a witnessed discriminant. It does not perform a split or classify any member.
QrStampIntakeSeed: Initializes an intake directly from one nonempty stamp and its anchor fold, with a witnessed epoch and discriminant.
QrEmptyIntakeSeed: Creates an empty root-profile intake at an anchor. Its set polynomial is one, so empty epoch spans can still be represented.
QrIntakeMerge: Combines adjacent intake spans with matching epoch, discriminant, and profile, checking the product of their contents.
QrIntakeSplit: Checks a factorization of the intake contents into residue and non-residue sets. Witness order is non_residue, residue; output slot order is residue, non_residue. Classification is proved by QrSideSelect and QrSideDescend.
QrSideSelect: Pins the interpolant and quotient commitments and checks the exceptional value at −R is assigned to the residue side. QrSideDescend checks the class identity. The header copies the split’s non_residue_hash, not a hash of the quotient.
QrSideDescend: Checks the interpolant/quotient identity for the discarded sibling’s class, then carries the selected child down one profile level. It matches the selection metadata and split hash and rejects equal sides. The retained child may include stray sibling-class members; exclusion consumers must still open it nonzero.
QrBucketSeal: Seals an intake between the current epoch entry and the next epoch entry. The predecessor anchor witness fixes the starting sentinel; the intake end is folded into the next entry. Whole-chain membership is enforced when the resulting anchors are checked against the chain.
QrUnspentInit: Routes a witnessed value to a bucket, proves it is absent there, and initializes the elapsed nullifier sequence with the bucket's epoch boundaries.
UnspentLift: Extends absence evidence by one adjacent sealed epoch, checking the new value's routing and exclusion and the extended sequence polynomial.
UnspentFuse: Joins adjacent absence intervals and checks their combined elapsed sequence polynomial.
UnspentBind: Binds arbitrary exclusion evidence to a note's derived nullifier sequence. The output NfSeqPoly is the complement sequence, not the elapsed sequence.
EvidenceTreeLeafPair: Hashes two compatible bucket leaves into a pair of evidence-tree roots.
EvidenceTreeFuse: Combines two pairs into a four-child evidence-tree node with matching epoch and anchor metadata.
EvidenceTreeCap: Raises a tree by one level, repeating its root in all four child positions. This pads the depth to a multiple of EvidenceTreeDescend’s fixed path length; it cannot add new leaves.
EvidenceTreeDescend: Checks the witnessed tree path and produces a descendant root while preserving epoch, discriminant, and anchor metadata.
EvidenceTreeOpen: Opens a bucket leaf for a witnessed profile and contents polynomial. The polynomial's bridge commitment must match the leaf root.
AnchorSpanSeed: Creates an anchor span for a stamp fold and commits its anchor membership set. Such spans cannot cross an epoch sentinel.
AnchorSpanFuse: Joins adjacent anchor spans, checking the combined anchor-set polynomial.
ActionMerge: Combines action and tachygram sets at a common anchor by checking both polynomial products.
ActionLift: Moves Actions to the end of a proven AnchorSpan, possibly keeping the same anchor. Both polynomial slots pass through unchanged.
FeeFuse: Adds the fee transition to Actions using the maximum-fee note opening and fee amount, producing a Stamp with the output sets.
FeeSeed: Creates a zero-action bundle’s zero-fee Stamp from a maximum-fee note opening, an anchor, and singleton fee sets.
StampMerge: Combines two stamps at a common anchor and checks the products of their action and tachygram sets.
StampLift: Moves a Stamp along a proven AnchorSpan. The witnessed action set is checked against the input; the tachygram set passes through.
StampUnmerge: Removes the right stamp from the left stamp by checking right × output = left for both polynomial sets. The output sets are the witnessed quotients.
